Modified file: media-sink.ts, available in this directory.
Generative.download changes: both sample-iterator return methods synchronously close native AVC decoders without custom codecs or alpha, before returning. This prevents overlap with the next clip during a canceled EOF flush.
Unmodified upstream package and remaining source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mediabunny/v/1.55.5
